description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A round tray divided into six wedge-shaped compartments around one central well. Side: Low radial woven dividers sit on a rigid bamboo bottom. Rear: The uninterrupted outer wall shows the backs of divider attachment points. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the same exact divided round rattan serving tray, currently photographed from above. Correct ONLY the CAMERA to a true dead-on FRONT ELEVATION, camera level with the midpoint of the shallow tray's side wall, azimuth zero. The round rim must become a narrow horizontal ellipse; the interior floor and most divider floors must be hidden behind the near rim. Absolutely no top-down, overhead or three-quarter view. Preserve its identical round shape, six wedge compartments and central well, natural tan finish, weave and bound bamboo rim. Keep it resting flat on the same warm-white studio surface; do not stand it upright or tilt it. Whole tray visible with generous margins. No text, labels, numerals, logos, marks or other objects.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
